title: Email/copy: mailboxIds not checked for empty
description: Email/copy does not check that mailboxIds is non-empty. RFC 8621 §6.1 requires at least one mailboxId. Email/import (line 889-897) and Email/set create (line 441-453) both validate this; copy does not. A client sending mailboxIds={} would silently create an email with no mailbox.
